lines.rom: suno ji bhairava larile kara jora kara vinati karum krpa tumhari cahie maim dhyana tumhara hi dharum
maim carana chuta apake arji meri suna lijiye maim hum mati ka manda meri kucha madada to kijiye mahima tumhari bahuta kucha thori si maim varnana karum
karate savari svana ki carom disa mem rajya hai jitane bhuta aura preta sabake apa hi sarataja haim hathiyara haim jo apake usaka kya varnana karum
